discharged: Every original primitive form of source weight k>=2 and every prescribed prime construct its genuine local coefficient field and either the nonzero original parabolic complex H1 eigenclass with simultaneous integral reduction or a continuous rank-two residual Galois representation on the arithmetic group of support Q*p. On every good prime ell of the original level Q distinct from p, the trace at every original residue Frobenius is the actual original Fourier coefficient reduced through the constructed local embedding, and the determinant is ell^((k-1).toNat). The representation kills original norm inertia there. The source parity theorem proves the exact twist exponent, Q|M|Q*p^2 proves that all these primes are good for the intermediate level and that the arithmetic extensions at Q*p and M*p coincide.
